plain: Looking closely into something; in an election, going over the votes

example.quote: In every state, probably, in the Union, the press has exerted a freedom in canvassing the merits and measures of public men, of every description, which has not been confined to the strict limits of the common law.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
